knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
sudan_climate <- read.csv("sudan_outbreak_temp.csv")
```

```{r}
sudan_climate <- sudan_climate %>%
  rename(T = avg_t)
```


```{r}
#TSI
# Based on Gaythorpe et al. / Mordecai et al. parameters for Aedes aegypti
calculate_tsi <- function(temp) {

# Biting rate (a) 
  
a_c    <- 0.000272  # Scaling constant
a_Tmin <- 13.35     # Thermal minimum 
a_Tmax <- 40.13     # Thermal maximum

# Biting rate (a) calculation
a <- a_c * temp * (temp - a_Tmin) * sqrt(pmax(0, a_Tmax - temp)) #Brière thermal response

# Use the variables for the cutoff
a <- ifelse(temp > a_Tmin & temp < a_Tmax, a, 0)
  


# Mortality (mu) - 1/lifespan

mu_c    <- 0.148 #Mordecai 2017
mu_Tmin <- 9.16
mu_Tmax <- 37.73

lf <- mu_c * (temp - mu_Tmin) * (mu_Tmax - temp) #quadratic thermal response
mu <- 1 / pmax(lf, 1) #provide floor, avoid dividing by zero


#PDR or Incubation rate (1/EIP)
c_eip <- 0.0001
tmin_eip <- 17.67
tmax_eip <- 42.1

# Calculate the Rate (PDR) or sigma_v
sigma_v = c_eip * temp * (temp - tmin_eip) * sqrt(pmax(0, tmax_eip - temp)) #Brière thermal response
sigma_v = ifelse(temp <= tmin_eip | temp >= tmax_eip, 0, sigma_v)


# Total TSI
tsi_val <- ifelse(sigma_v > 0 & a > 0, (a^2 * exp(-mu / sigma_v)) / mu, 0)
  
 # Return all components 
  return(data.frame(
    a = a,
    mu = mu,
    sigma_v = sigma_v,
    TSI = pmax(tsi_val, 0)
  ))
}

```


```{r}
# Use rowwise to apply the function to each temperature value 'T'
sudan_TSI <- sudan_climate %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(date = date, T = T, calculate_tsi(T))

# View the first few rows
head(sudan_TSI)
    ```
    
    

```{r}
save(sudan_TSI, file = "sudan_TSI.RData")
```
